question: Are you planning on writing about Abel and Medium’s newlywed life?　When did you decide that these two would get married?
answer: If I were to say whether I would write about it or not, I have no prospects at the moment. However, I might write about it in the bonus Short Story. The bonus Short Story is a series, so right now there is a Short Story with Cecils, Arakiya, and Spica as the main characters, which is set in Vollachia. I think Abel and Medium will also be in it, so I don’t know if it will be the main story (about their newlywed life itself), but I might write it as a sub-episode. Flop and Medium were characters that were not in the original conception, and when I thought about how to write the ending for the two of them, I thought that Flop, who is a shrewd guy, would go for the biggest thing, and if he did, he would make Medium the queen (of the emperor).　Furthermore, Abel and Medium spent a surprisingly large amount of time together, so I thought this could work, and that’s when the characters of Flop and Medium were solidified.
